name: short-email
label: Short and specific
subject: Quick question about your experience
body: Hey Sam, saw you just hit your first 100 signups — that's great.
Would you be up for leaving a quick testimonial? Takes under a minute.
No pressure at all if now's not a good time.

name: before-you-send
label: Checklist
title: Before you hit send
items: Sent right after a recent win
From a real person, not no-reply
Link in the first four lines
Says it takes under a minute
Gives an easy way to say not now
